Original User Story: As a site member, I want to describe myself on my own page in a semi-structured way, so that others can learn about me.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site member, I want to create a semi-structured personal description on my profile page so that others can easily understand my background, interests, and skills, fostering better connections within the community.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Users should be able to fill out at least 5 predefined fields (e.g., bio, interests, skills, achievements, and contact information) with a character limit of 300 characters per field.
- The profile description should be editable at any time, with changes saved and reflected in real-time for at least 99% of users.
- The system should allow users to preview their description before finalizing it, ensuring that at least 90% of users find the preview feature helpful.

Test Outline:
- Verify that users can successfully fill out and save information in all required fields, ensuring adherence to character limits.
- Conduct user testing to confirm that the real-time updates and preview features function correctly and meet user expectations.

Original User Story: As a site member, I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Practitioner, so that I can earn that designation.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site member, I want to complete an application for the Certified Scrum Practitioner designation so that I can enhance my professional credentials and demonstrate my expertise in Scrum methodologies.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The application form should be accessible and fully functional, allowing users to submit their applications within 10 minutes.
- At least 90% of submitted applications should be processed and acknowledged within 24 hours.
- The application approval rate should be ≥85% based on the eligibility criteria outlined on the site.

Test Outline:
- Track the time taken by users to complete the application form to ensure it meets the 10-minute requirement.
- Monitor the processing time for applications and verify that 90% receive acknowledgment within the specified timeframe.

Original User Story: As a trainer, I want to list my upcoming classes in my profile and include a link to a detailed page about each, so that prospective attendees can find my courses.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a trainer, I want to display my upcoming classes on my profile along with links to detailed pages for each class, so that potential attendees can easily access information about my courses and make informed decisions to enroll.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The profile should list at least 5 upcoming classes with accurate dates and times, updated in real-time.
- Each class entry must include a functional link to a detailed page that provides comprehensive information, including syllabus, prerequisites, and instructor details.
- The system should ensure that at least 90% of users can access the class details page within 3 seconds of clicking the link.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the upcoming classes are displayed correctly on the trainer's profile and check for real-time updates.
- Test the functionality of the links to ensure they direct users to the correct detailed pages and measure the loading time for each page.

Original User Story: As a site member, I want to mark my profile as private in which case only my name will appear, so that no one can learn things about me I don't want shared.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site member, I want the option to set my profile to private, ensuring that only my name is visible to others, so that I can protect my personal information and maintain my privacy.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Users should be able to toggle the privacy setting within 1 minute, with a confirmation message displayed immediately after the change.
- When the profile is set to private, only the user's name should be visible to other members, with 100% compliance verified through user testing.
- The system must allow users to switch back to a public profile at any time, with changes reflected in real-time.

Test Outline:
- Measure the time taken for users to change their profile privacy settings to ensure it meets the 1-minute requirement.
- Conduct user testing to verify that only the name is displayed when the profile is set to private.
